requirement_text.REQ-419:
Build-order M1 (docs/mobile/build-order.md): MOB-1 in docs/mobile/requirements.md, placement and stack per docs/mobile/architecture.md §2, stack settled by docs/migration/decisions/0012-mobile-tier-stack.md (not re-decided here). This requirement creates apps/mobile/; nothing in it authenticates or fetches (that is REQ-421).

BUILDS:
1. `flutter create --org com.bizdala --project-name letflow --platforms android,ios apps/mobile` (Android applicationId and iOS bundle id com.bizdala.letflow -- must match REQ-418's redirect scheme). Android minSdk 26 in android/app/build.gradle(.kts); iOS deployment target 15.0 in ios/Podfile and the Xcode project.
2. pubspec.yaml: environment pins `sdk` to the Dart 3.11 line and a `flutter: 3.41.7` constraint; dependencies go_router, flutter_riverpod, dio, flutter_appauth, flutter_secure_storage, intl -- nothing else at runtime yet.
3. lib/ layout exactly per architecture.md §2 (bootstrap/, auth/, api/, definitions/, renderers/{form,list,process,task}/, features/, design_system/, i18n/, shared/), a ProviderScope root, and a go_router with a placeholder slug-entry route. A renderer registry keyed by definition type returning an explicit "unsupported definition type" widget for an unknown type -- never a blank screen.
4. analysis_options.yaml including flutter_lints (or stricter).
5. THREE STATIC GUARDS under apps/mobile/test/guards/, each with a self-test proving it fires: (a) module boundary (0039 D3), (b) forbidden dependencies (no script runtime, no CEL, no webview), (c) no compiled-in tenant identifier.
6. apps/mobile/README.md and a docs/mobile/README.md 'Nothing is built' line update.

iOS: files are generated and configured; building them is DEFERRED -- the build host is Windows and cannot run Xcode. Recorded, not dropped.

task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-419 before it is marked done. 1) Re-run scripts/test_parallel.sh yourself (TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 is the documented clean value for this host per the prior TEST-RUNNER recheck -- do not simply trust its report). 2) Confirm each of REQ-419's 8 acceptance criteria against the actual code/tests directly, not against any prior agent's summary: run flutter analyze and flutter test yourself from apps/mobile/; run flutter build apk --debug and the two grep checks; run the git ls-files directory-listing check; inspect ios/Podfile for the platform line; run git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD and confirm scope (apps/mobile/ + docs/mobile/README.md, plus the expected ORCH/agent bookkeeping paths -- docs/requirements.yaml, docs/status/, handoffs/WF02-REQ419-20260927/, lib/letflow/design/req419-mobile-scaffold.md, test/specs/REQ-419.md, docs/issues/ISS-0874.yaml -- judge whether that bookkeeping-plus-scaffold shape satisfies AC8's intent or whether it's a genuine scope violation). 3) Check docs/status/requirement_status.yaml and docs/requirements.yaml for staleness relative to what actually shipped (REQ-419's status is currently in_progress -- do not flip it yourself, that is DOC-UPDATER's job at Step 6, but confirm nothing else drifted). 4) Re-derive the backend failure attribution structurally yourself (per core-directives.md) -- do not accept the prior TEST-RUNNER runs' attributions on their say-so; your re-run will very likely not reproduce their exact failure set, and that is expected.
acceptance_criteria: Independent full-suite re-run performed and quoted, TEST_PARALLEL_N noted
Every one of REQ-419's 8 acceptance criteria independently reverified against actual code/output, not against a prior summary
